correctness.rationale: The independent equal-width stratum samples make Q_n unbiased, with variance the sum of cell variances divided by n². Fix a cell increment Δ and normalized t=Δ/(L H), H=1/n. Every monotone L-Lipschitz path pushes uniform cell sampling to a probability law containing t·Uniform[0,1]; since y²≤y, the remaining law yields Var≤Δ²(1/4−t/6), with equality for a centered slope-L ramp and equal endpoint plateaux. Set t_i=nΔ_i/L∈[0,1], Σt_i≤s=n min(1,L)/L. The exact cubic h(t)=t²(3−2t)/12 and h(x)+h(y)=h(x+y)+(x+y−1)xy/2 imply a global maximizing vector with k equal positive entries s/k and zeros otherwise. Thus the exact maximum is (L²/n4) max_{ceil(s)≤k≤n}[s²/(4k)−s³/(6k²)]. Differentiate continuous k to get nearest feasible integer 4s/3; L≤1, 1≤L≤4/3, fixed L>4/3, and L≥n boundary formulas follow. Independently checked exact cubic identity and exact optimizer fractions n=1,2,5,11,12,15 with L fractions. The proof supplies the infinite-dimensional bound, not numerical optimization.
